reviewItems.issue: Source pay app contract sum is $28,485, but user corrected job contract to $34,000.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: The app should not force the billing source to overwrite the project contract total.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Store pay-app contract sum separately from app/project contract override; flag for reconciliation.

reviewItems.issue: G702 balance to finish includes retainage; G703 SOV balance is contract minus completed only.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: The summary table and SOV detail will show different balance numbers by design.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Store both Balance To Finish including retainage and SOV Balance C-G; label them clearly.

reviewItems.issue: Pay app is essentially a retainage/release billing.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Completed/stored is already 100%; current due is only $347.87.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Add billing type = Retainage Release / Final Current Due.

reviewItems.issue: G703 displays 0% total due rounding, but calculation is $10,000 / $2,010,000 = about 0.50%.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: The app should calculate precise percent while preserving source display if needed.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Show calculated percent and optional source percent.

reviewItems.issue: Scanned PDF SOV was entered from rendered image, not native text.
reviewItems.whyItMatters: Line-level extraction should be reviewed once inside the app.
reviewItems.recommendedBehavior: Set imported SOV confidence to Medium and require review approval before locking.
